title: Scene-Conditioned PINN-GNN for Multipath RF Maps: Cross-Scene Generation and In-Scene Completion
abstract: arXiv:2607.01777v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Radio frequency (RF) maps provide a compact representation of multipath propagation characteristics and are fundamental to channel modeling, coverage analysis, and environment-aware wireless optimization. This paper proposes a unified RF map construction framework based on a physics-informed neural network (PINN) and a graph neural network (GNN), supporting both cross-scene generation and in-scene completion with 2D and 2.5D environmental representations. The PINN embeds electromagnetic propagation constraints to establish a physically consistent mapping from receiver locations to multipath parameters, including path gain, time of arrival, and angles, while the GNN enforces spatial consistency by modeling correlations among neighboring receivers. translated_title: 场景条件化的PINN-GNN多径射频地图：跨场景生成与场景内补全
translated_abstract: 射频（RF）地图提供了多径传播特性的紧凑表示，是信道建模、覆盖分析和环境感知无线优化的基础。本文提出了一种基于物理信息神经网络（PINN）和图神经网络（GNN）的统一射频地图构建框架，支持跨场景生成和场景内补全两种任务，并采用2D和2.5D两种环境表示。PINN嵌入电磁传播约束，建立从接收机位置到多径参数（包括路径增益、到达时间和角度）的物理一致映射，而GNN通过建模相邻接收机之间的相关性来保证空间一致性。为了全面评估多径重建质量，我们提出了一种峰值加权动态时间规整度量，可联合考虑幅度误差和峰值延迟错位。
tldr: 本文提出一种融合物理信息神经网络（PINN）与图神经网络（GNN）的统一射频地图构建框架，通过嵌入电磁传播约束实现物理一致的多径参数预测，并借助图结构建模空间相关性，同时支持跨场景生成与场景内补全两类任务。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified RF map construction framework combining a physics-informed neural network (PINN) with a graph neural network (GNN), which embeds electromagnetic propagation constraints for physically consistent multipath parameter prediction and enforces spatial consistency via graph-structured correlations, supporting both cross-scene generation and in-scene completion.
